Audience

Leave all organizations unselected to show Portal+ to everyone who already has JSM access. Select organizations to create an audience-specific experience.

Use Ctrl/Cmd to select more than one organization.

Status mapping

Map your customer-facing statuses into Portal+'s consistent dashboard states.

This is deliberately configurable. Portal+ will not assume that every Jira site uses status names such as “Waiting for customer” or “In progress”.

Discovered request types

These are being read directly from the JSM service desk and will become the source for Portal+ service categories.
